picks.title: New Haven low-cost air sensor network (Yale Planetary Solutions project)
picks.why: Local sensor readings can support neighborhood comparisons and paired monitor analysis.
picks.limitations: Ask the project team for access and check sensor locations, completeness and both years.
picks.yale_note: A Yale Planetary Solutions project; sensor data need calibration against a reference monitor.

picks.title: PurpleAir low-cost sensors
picks.why: Historical point measurements offer another source of local sensor observations.
picks.limitations: Requires an API key; historical coverage and street-level density must be checked.

picks.title: EPA Air Quality System (AirData)
picks.why: Find state-operated PM2.5 monitor metadata and reference observations for matched comparisons.
picks.limitations: Verify monitor location, method and hourly data availability; remote sensors are not collocated.

picks.title: OpenStreetMap extracts (Geofabrik)
picks.why: Street centerlines define segment-level mapping units.
picks.limitations: Current geometry may differ from historic streets and does not itself measure pollution.

picks.title: New_Haven_Neighborhood_Boundaries
picks.why: City neighborhood boundaries distinguish Dwight from East Rock.
picks.limitations: Service access timed out; verify boundaries and historical validity.

methods.name: Matched sensor comparison
methods.why: Pair quality-controlled hourly observations and calculate bias, MAE and correlation, reporting separation and sample size.

methods.name: Street and neighborhood comparison
methods.why: Compare matched dates and seasons; map only well-supported street segments and quantify uncertainty and missing coverage.

methods.name: Calibration and sensitivity
methods.why: Compare raw and humidity-corrected sensor readings, with independent validation when collocated data exist.

next_steps: Confirm state monitor identity, methods and hourly availability.
Inspect sensor availability and collocation in each year before asserting street-level differences.
Request Yale network data and verify city boundary service.
